text:
The local birdwatching society is organizing its annual spring census this weekend.
            To catch the rarest arrivals, our primary observation team will meet tomorrow at first light.
            We will assemble down by the historic old mill, as the surrounding wetlands have seen an unusual increase in waterfowl this season.
            From there, the group's coordinator will help us map out the next phase of our tracking efforts.
            Participants are advised to bring their own binoculars and wear weather-appropriate clothing before we distribute the sector maps and begin the count.
